protocol_notes.reported_vs_reproduced: Every paper cell is reported evidence; only CSV cells with local_status=reproduced have a verifiable local baseline artifact. Paper VizWiz starred cells were reproduced by the paper authors on val, not by our current local experiment.
protocol_notes.vizwiz: Paper Table1 caption explicitly marks star as validation. Supplement10.1 states its VizWiz experiments used validation. Table2 starred entries follow this convention. FULL dual cells show historical test / starred val: v15=50.1/55.6*,NeXT=55.2/60.9*. Local val4319 must compare only starred values. VizWiz excluded from Table1/2 Avg.
protocol_notes.sqa: SQA_IMG2017 differs from overall4241. Latest main rows retain complete self-generated CQM-I results. FULL-only original shipped CQM-A input control on all2017 image questions raised64.8488 to69.5092, only-0.0908 below paper69.6;196 rescued/102 broken,parse failures17 to0. Exact authors CQM-I input is unknown. This establishes input formatting as the main cause of this FULL reproduction gap, without assuming any pruned-arm or NeXT improvement.
protocol_notes.llava_vs_next_budget: LLaVA1.5 all576 ->128/64/32. NeXT all2880 ->640/320/160 TOTAL nominal (local CLI128/64/32 equivalent overfive crops); realized importance-proportional crop allocation can round down.
protocol_notes.qwen_resolution_pipeline: Paper Qwen3-VL-8B fixed1024 visual tokens (official README fixed1024x1024). Official legacy pruned generation drops DeepStack and supplies no native mRoPE image-grid positions. Native restored pipeline is not the reported legacy pruned pipeline.
protocol_notes.generation_and_guidance: LLaVA official conv vicuna_v1, greedy; TextVQA official model_vqa_loader guidance removes trailing short-answer instruction and defaults128 output tokens. Local TextVQA model_vqa wrapper passes full guidance and caps1024; effect currently unmeasured.
protocol_notes.mme: Table1/2 arithmetic uses MME Perception only /20; Table4 uses total(P+C)/20. These are distinct metric scopes. Never swap P+C into Table1/2 arithmetic. CPU official-template comparison discovered162 flipped labels in reconstructed LLaVA GT; current LMUData TSV agrees with official GT on all2374. Comparison.csv MME rows now use corrected official labels, preserving old scores in mme_official_gt_rescore.json. Raw predictions are unchanged.
protocol_notes.hallusion: fAcc use is an inference from official score outputs and paper values, not an explicit paper metric statement. Preserve this uncertainty.
protocol_notes.mmbench: Current full circular-group denominator1292 supersedes denominator-filtered historical means;4876 rotation rows are not1292 independent groups.
protocol_notes.pope: Question-ID alignment required. Latest accepted local asked set=random2910+popular3000+adversarial3000. Mean F1 used for paper-oriented comparison based on LLaVA convention; paper does not explicitly name F1. Exact local-vs-paper ID-set identity unverified.
protocol_notes.info_vqa: Local current export hash differs bundled pin;2801 local questions/answers agree fresh current export. Paper exact TSV version unknown.
protocol_notes.implementation_identity: Existing audit found newline-normalized official/current identity in LLaVA llava_arch.py,clip_encoder.py,builder.py,model_vqa_science.py,eval_science_qa.py and Qwen model/pruner.py. This rules out edits in those files, not all environment/input differences.

mme_v15_deficits.label_provenance: Official MME eval_tool.zip Your_Results and LaVIN GT both identical to current LMUData TSV2374 labels. Local reconstructed GT has162 flipped labels. Corrected CPU scores replace corrupted metrics.
